title: Migrating a legacy feature toggle to OpenFeature
answers: How do I migrate a feature toggle from config.featureToggles to OpenFeature?
How to add React hook support for an existing LegacyFrontend feature flag?
Why does my feature flag need entries in openfeature.gen.ts and openfeature-types.gen.d.ts?
body: To move an existing feature toggle onto OpenFeature while keeping it registered as a legacy flag (naming convention not yet OpenFeature-style), set `Generate: Generate{LegacyFrontend: true, React: true}` on its FeatureFlag entry in pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go. This regenerates packages/grafana-runtime/src/internal/openFeature/openfeature.gen.ts (adds a FlagKeys entry and a `useFlag<Name>()` hook) and openfeature-types.gen.d.ts (adds the key to the flag key union). Replace `config.featureToggles.<name>` call sites: use the generated `useFlag<Name>()` hook in React components, or `getFeatureFlagClient().getBooleanValue(FlagKeys.<Name>, false)` in non-React code (both imported from '@grafana/runtime/internal').
applies: Any PR migrating a Go-registered feature toggle in pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go to OpenFeature consumption on the frontend
